title: User Authentication Success
description: Verify that users can successfully authenticate using correct credentials with appropriate role and department access restrictions applied.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page.
Enter valid username and password credentials.
Click the login button.
Verify user is logged in successfully.
Verify the user interface matches the user's assigned role and department permissions.

title: User Authentication Failure
description: Verify system behavior when users attempt to login with invalid or incorrect credentials.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page.
Enter invalid username or incorrect password.
Click the login button.
Verify login is rejected.
Verify appropriate error message is displayed without revealing sensitive system information.

title: Equipment CRUD Operations
description: Validate creation, reading, updating, and deletion of medical equipment entries including data validation and real-time reflection in system.

steps.description: Login with equipment manager role.
Create a new medical equipment entry with valid detailed technical data.
Verify equipment entry is saved successfully and appears in inventory list.
Modify existing equipment details.
Verify updated equipment data is immediately reflected in the system.
Delete an equipment entry.
Verify equipment is removed and no longer visible in inventory.
Try to create or update equipment with invalid or missing mandatory data.
Verify system rejects invalid input with clear validation errors.

title: Equipment Bulk Import via Excel
description: Verify ability to bulk import equipment data from Excel files with validation and error feedback.

steps.description: Login with appropriate role that allows bulk import.
Upload a well-formed Excel file containing multiple equipment records.
Verify that all valid records are correctly imported into the system.
Upload an Excel file with some invalid or incomplete data.
Verify system provides detailed feedback on records rejected due to validation errors, without corrupting existing data.

title: Equipment QR Code Scanning
description: Validate QR code scanner correctly identifies equipment and surfaces appropriate options.

steps.description: Use QR code scanner on a known equipment’s QR code from mobile or desktop interface.
Verify correct equipment details are displayed.
Verify actionable options such as creating repair requests and viewing usage history are accessible.
Attempt scanning invalid or unregistered QR code.
Verify user is informed about the unrecognized QR code gracefully.

title: Real-Time Equipment Usage Session Tracking
description: Verify starting and stopping equipment usage sessions updates status in real-time and synchronizes across clients.

steps.description: Login and select equipment.
Start a usage session on the equipment.
Verify usage session is recorded and active usage indicator appears.
Stop the usage session.
Verify session is ended and status updates accordingly.
Confirm changes are reflected in real-time for other logged-in users.

title: Repair Request Workflow
description: Validate creation, approval, and tracking of repair requests with proper department and role authorization.

steps.description: Login as user authorized to create repair requests.
Create a new repair request for specific equipment.
Verify request is created and visible in the repair request list.
Login as an authorized approver.
Approve the repair request.
Verify request status updates to approved.
Track request to completion.
Verify status updates correctly and audit logs reflect changes.

title: Maintenance Plan Creation and Bulk Scheduling
description: Verify users can create maintenance plans, add tasks, and apply bulk scheduling with accurate progress tracking.

steps.description: Login as a maintenance planner.
Create a new maintenance plan with required details.
Verify the maintenance plan is saved and listed.
Add individual maintenance tasks to the plan.
Schedule multiple tasks in batch.
Verify scheduled tasks are saved with correct dates.
Mark some tasks as completed individually and in bulk.
Verify completion status is updated and progress percentage reflects accurately.

title: Equipment Transfer Management
description: Verify equipment transfer request creation, approval, tracking for internal and external transfers with full audit trails.

steps.description: Login with transfer management rights.
Initiate equipment transfer request between departments.
Verify transfer request is created and visible with pending status.
Approve the transfer request as an authorized user.
Verify status changes to approved.
Track transfer through completion.
Verify audit trail reflects all actions and status changes.
Repeat process for external transfer scenario.

title: Administrative User Management
description: Ensure administrators can create, edit, disable, and assign roles and departments for users with immediate effect.

steps.description: Login as administrator.
Create a new user with assigned roles and departments.
Verify new user is created and visible in user management list.
Edit user role and department assignments.
Verify changes are saved and reflected immediately.
Disable a user account.
Verify user cannot authenticate anymore and is marked as disabled.

title: Dashboard and Reporting Accuracy
description: Validate that interactive dashboards display correct up-to-date metrics and reports export data correctly.

steps.description: Login and navigate to dashboard.
Verify key equipment, maintenance, and usage metrics are accurate and current.
Open reporting modules including inventory and performance reports.
Verify charts and data visualizations reflect correct aggregated data.
Use export functionality to download reports.
Verify exported files contain correct data matching on-screen display.

title: Progressive Web App Installation and Offline Mode
description: Verify PWA installation on supported devices, offline usability, and push notification functionality.

steps.description: Access the web app on a supported mobile device.
Trigger PWA installation flow and install the app.
Verify app appears as installed and launches independently.
Use the app offline, navigating cached pages and data.
Verify offline functionality works correctly with cached equipment and usage data.
Verify push notifications are received when online.

title: Real-Time Data Synchronization
description: Ensure updates to equipment status and usage data synchronize immediately across multiple clients.

steps.description: Open the application on two different clients logged in as relevant users.
Perform an equipment status update or start/stop a usage session on the first client.
Verify change reflects in real-time on the second client without page refresh.

title: Import and Export Data Integrity
description: Verify bulk import and export of equipment data via Excel files processes without data corruption and provides user feedback.

steps.description: Export current equipment data to Excel from the system.
Verify exported file content matches the equipment data.
Modify the exported Excel file data and import it back.
Verify the system updates equipment records based on import, preserving data integrity.
Attempt to import malformed or corrupted Excel file.
Verify the system handles the error gracefully and reports clear import errors without affecting existing data.

title: Performance under Load
description: Verify the system meets performance benchmarks for loading times and responsiveness under typical and peak usage.

steps.description: Simulate multiple concurrent users performing common operations such as equipment search, usage logging, and navigation.
Measure and verify page load times remain within acceptable limits.
Verify user actions respond within defined performance thresholds.

title: Role and Department-Based Access Control Enforcement
description: Ensure system restricts or grants access to functionality according to user roles and department assignments.

steps.description: Login as a user with limited department role.
Attempt to access restricted modules and operations outside assigned department or role.
Verify access is denied and user is presented with appropriate message.
Login as administrator.
Ensure full access is granted including user management and all equipment.

title: Error Handling and User Feedback
description: Validate that the system handles errors gracefully with user-friendly messages for scenarios including network failures, invalid inputs, and authorization failures.

steps.description: Simulate network failure during equipment update.
Verify system informs user of failure without data loss.
Attempt invalid form submission for creating maintenance plan.
Verify detailed validation error messages appear alongside the respective input fields.
Attempt unauthorized access to restricted page.
Verify access denied messages appear and navigation is restricted.
